page_job: Own broad Metro Atlanta rodent-removal intent and route species or symptom-specific visitors to the correct service owner without duplicating those owners in the title or H1.

intent_owners.phrase: rat and mouse removal Metro ATL

evidence.supports: Attic noise can come from mice, bats, squirrels, raccoons, or other wildlife; time of day is a clue, not a diagnosis.
Do not sweep or vacuum dry rodent urine, droppings, or nests; cleanup method and PPE depend on conditions.
Bat exclusions should be avoided April 1 through July 31; maternity-season exclusion requires a licensed nuisance wildlife control operator.

asset_rights.production_rights: must be re-confirmed with the exact artifact at the human approval gate

boundaries: Symptoms are routing clues, not a species diagnosis.
Raccoon and bat are explicitly labeled as non-rodent lookalikes.
No ranking, lead, response-time, warranty, or health-outcome claim is made.
The clean review URL is not added to the production sitemap and does not change production redirects or index state.
